verdict.rationale: Pulumi's CLI and Automation API are explicitly designed for headless/non-interactive use, and hands-on probes confirm `pulumi preview`/`up`/`destroy` run non-interactively with structured JSON output and exit codes suitable for CI automation, even without Pulumi Cloud (local backend). Native VCS/CI integrations and an Automation API for embedding Pulumi programmatically further support CI-native workflows.
